annotations.exact_quote: Text Clustering via Constrained Nonnegative Matrix Factorization
annotations.reason_zh: 标题明确以约束非负矩阵分解作为文本聚类核心方法，满足非负矩阵分解定义。

annotations.exact_quote: The semi-supervised NMF methods can be divided into two types, one is based on the explicit category labels, the other is based on the pair wise constraints including must-link and cannot-link.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确研究半监督NMF，并利用must-link与cannot-link成对约束指导聚类，符合有限监督/成对约束的半监督学习设定。

annotations.exact_quote: In the new method, must-link constraints are used to control the distance of the data in the compressed form, and cannot-ink constraints are used to control the encoding factor.
annotations.reason_zh: 有限标注或成对约束构成不完整监督，并作为本文实质研究设定；词表中弱监督与半监督没有父子关系，应补充弱监督标签。
